title: Authentication HTTP helpers
responsibility: Build uncached auth responses and validate bounded JSON requests and authentication headers.

inputs.name: authHttp.options
inputs.description: Optional HTTP status, default 200, and separate Set-Cookie values.

inputs.name: authRedirect.location
inputs.description: Redirect destination supplied by the caller.

inputs.name: authRedirect.cookies
inputs.description: Cookie headers to append; defaults to none.

inputs.name: authFailure.error
inputs.description: Unknown failure to turn into a public auth response.

inputs.name: sameOrigin.request
inputs.description: Request whose Origin header is checked.

inputs.name: hasAuthorization.request
inputs.description: Request to inspect for an Authorization header.

inputs.name: bearerToken.request
inputs.description: Request to inspect for an opaque Bearer token.

inputs.name: boundedText.body
inputs.description: Byte stream to read, or null for an empty body.

inputs.name: boundedText.limit
inputs.description: Maximum accumulated body size in bytes.

inputs.name: readJson.request
inputs.description: Request requiring application/json and an object body of at most 16384 bytes.

inputs.name: authPath.request
inputs.description: Request whose URL path is checked.

outputs.name: authHttp
outputs.description: JSON response with no-store and no-sniff headers and optional cookies.

outputs.name: authRedirect
outputs.description: 303 redirect with no-store, no-sniff and no-referrer headers and optional cookies.

outputs.name: authFailure
outputs.description: AuthFailure code/status response, or opaque auth-unavailable with status 500 for other failures.

outputs.name: sameOrigin
outputs.description: True when the Origin header exactly equals the supplied origin.

outputs.name: hasAuthorization
outputs.description: True when the Authorization header exists, even if invalid or empty.

outputs.name: bearerToken
outputs.description: Token from exact Bearer syntax with 32 to 128 allowed characters, otherwise null.

outputs.name: boundedText
outputs.description: Strict UTF-8 text; null for oversized, invalid UTF-8 or failed streams. Oversized reads cancel the stream.

outputs.name: readJson
outputs.description: Parsed non-array JSON object; rejects invalid content type, body size, encoding or JSON with invalid-request.
